reason: I've already been burned by a web designer who took my money and left me with half a site. A company in Kuwait with no UK office, no past clients and 50% upfront by PayPal is exactly the setup I swore I'd never fall for again.
objection: If they go quiet halfway through I've got no one local to chase and no reviews to check - and then they want monthly fees on top of the build on top of that.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of real Manchester businesses I can ring who they've built for, and a payment plan where most of the money is only paid once the site is live and working.
